'''2003 DPC Atlanta''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Atlanta, Georgia (February 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms. The [[Players Committee]] announced on 6 February 2003 that the event was being held that weekend and that, to celebrate the success of [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth|Virtual Set #4]], it had donated $100 in cash to the prize purse.<ref name="pc-champnews030206">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Dates:''' February 2003
